description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Digital Foundry has been a pioneer in digital innovation for over 25 years, specializing in partnering with Fortune 500 companies to create cutting-edge digital products. They are currently seeking a Software Engineer Associate to join their technology group in creating innovative software solutions for their clients.
Associate software engineer building, testing, and reviewing software solutions across diverse industries

Responsibilities:
• Work in a collaborative, team-centric environment utilizing agile principles
• Deliver high-quality solutions across multiple industries
• Collaborate with team to build software solutions where the problem is often ill defined
• Work on a variety of projects ranging in both size and scope
• Test your code and review the code of others
• Receive mentorship and accelerated learning
• Learn and adapt to new, complex development environments

Requirements:
• BS in Computer Science OR relevant work experience
• Proficiency in one or more of the following: C#, Java, Javascript, Golang, Python, and CSS
• Work authorization in the U.S. which does not require sponsorship by the employer for a visa
